item.title: Stepping out of the Unix Shell: Automating Sage 50 with C#
item.description:
I live in the terminal. My ecosystem is Unix, my language is Ruby, and my framework is Rails. So, when a project appeared that required building a Windows console application in C# to talk to a legacy desktop accounting software, I was bewildered.

Like asking a Canadian to cut queues.
